summary: DROP flag (reviews): Google 3.9/56. Otherwise: claimed RoverPass (isBookable, CRS) at $45 every sampled night, 50A FHU, pull-throughs to 80 ft, year-round, showers/laundry/wifi. Strong long-stay character (weekly $160, monthly $460; 'Peaceful living in a friendly community').
flags: DROP (reviews): Google Maps 'Lakeroad Village Park' 3.9 over 56 reviews - under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. RV Life 4* $$ (stored).

LONG-STAY (five tests): (1) the homepage leads with 'Peaceful living in a friendly community' and the operator's RoverPass email is 'troybuiltcommunities'; (2) weekly $160 costs less than four nights and monthly $460 is about ten nights - a pricing aimed at long stays; (3) nightly is sold openly online at $45 with no minimum; (4) occupancy: RoverPass offered 7 sites open on 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-21 and 9 in late January and June 2027, of an unpublished total (site numbers run to at least 18 plus lettered lots), so a good part of the park is held; (5) no seasonal waitlist or lease language found. I read it as a mixed park leaning long-stay; with the 3.9 Google rating it falls on the drop side under the 'under 4 stars plus borderline mostly seasonal' rule.

Price gate passes on its own: $45 a night on RoverPass and the operator's rates page. RoverPass listing is CLAIMED (isBookable true, systemType CRS, instant booking). Presence: website with phone 660-665-2228 (same on RoverPass and Google).
